notes: Starting: the strategy says 'I almost always started Crush The Rebellion in tourney games' (Presence Of The Force when the opponent gives one Force with their battlegrounds), and the list calls Twi'lek Advisor the 'Starting card', so Twi'lek Advisor is the starting Interrupt and Crush The Rebellion the starting Effect.
The description says the deck 'really helped me win states' but names no state (the 2000 California State Championship was won by Clayton Atkin), so the deck is filed as general with a player_note.
Posted 'U-3PO' dested U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio). Oppressive Enforcement is the Special Edition Effect (April 2000; Defensive Shields came later). Card comments in parentheses are kept in the posted text.
The strategy's 'Thinking of putting in/removing' lists and the 4-15 update ('Broken Concentration is going in') are not applied; dested as posted.
player_note: The post's description says: 'this is what really helped me win states' (posted 13 April 2000; the state is not named). The strategy adds: 'I almost always started Crush The Rebellion in tourney games.'
